name: qanoai-whatsappsupport
description: QanoAI WhatsAppSupport - AI-powered WhatsApp customer support platform

scripts.build:railway: prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @qanoai/shared build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/config build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/database build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/validation build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/permissions build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/queue build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/ai build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/api build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/worker build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/realtime build && pnpm --filter @qanoai/web build
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter worker dev" "pnpm --filter realtime dev"
